model.note: nominal URDF kinematics; the controller uses factory calibration, so a small FK disagreement is expected and is gated below

interpretation: Numerical feasibility only: reachability, joint limits, singularity proximity and flange clearance along densely sampled straight-line movel segments. Collision-freedom is NOT proven - there is no obstacle model. The lift/reorient/translate/descend structure plus a clearance height above every table object is the substitute, and it still needs human eyes on the workspace before execution.
